items.title: Alpiq Buys 90% of UK BESS Developer Harmony Energy
items.summary: Swiss power firm Alpiq is acquiring a 90% stake in pan-European battery storage developer Harmony Energy, adding roughly 400MW of under-construction assets and a multi-gigawatt project pipeline across the UK, Germany, France and Poland. Harmony will keep operating under its own brand, with co-founder Peter Kavanagh staying on as CEO with a 10% stake.

items.title: Frontier Power USA Converts 920MWh Texas BESS Portfolio
items.summary: Frontier Power USA exercised its selection right to bring four Texas battery projects developed by Stella Energy Solutions - Blanquilla, Aransas Pass, Nash and Wallis - onto its platform, representing roughly 230MW/920MWh of capacity. The projects are expected to use Eos Energy Enterprises' Z3 long-duration batteries, with closing contingent on Eos completing its rights offering.

items.title: Elestor, Windpark Zeewolde Deploy Hydrogen-Iron Flow Battery
items.summary: Dutch long-duration storage developer Elestor has partnered with Windpark Zeewolde to install a 20MW system with 200-800MWh of hydrogen-iron flow battery storage at what is described as Europe's largest onshore wind farm. The project pairs long-duration storage with one of the continent's biggest wind installations to boost grid flexibility.

items.title: Tesla Deploys Record 13.5 GWh of Energy Storage in Q2
items.summary: Tesla announced it deployed 13.5 GWh of energy storage products globally in Q2 2026, up 53% from the prior quarter and 40% year-over-year, marking its second-largest quarterly total ever. The company will report full financial results on July 22, with investors watching for updates on its VPP partnership with Sunrun and Renew Home.

items.title: BYD-Greenvolt and Envision Advance Gigawatt-Scale European BESS
items.summary: BYD Energy Storage and Greenvolt Power will co-develop a 600MW/2.4GWh storage facility in Siedlce, Poland, with construction planned to start in the third quarter of 2026 and operation targeted by the end of 2027. Separately, Envision Energy and Elements Green will deploy a 400MW/1,600MWh four-hour battery system in northern Germany using Envision's Gen 8 platform.

items.title: UChicago Lab Advances Sodium-Based Solid-State Battery Design
items.summary: Researchers from the University of Chicago Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering, led by professor Y. Shirley Meng, published new research in Joule introducing an approach to all-solid-state sodium-ion batteries that tackles longstanding limitations in ion transport, stability and temperature performance. The team's work is seen as raising the performance benchmark for sodium-based solid-state cells as a lithium alternative for large-scale energy storage.

items.title: New Solid Electrolyte Boosts Safety of Sodium-Ion Batteries
items.summary: A study published in Advanced Functional Materials details a composite polymer electrolyte with a functional 2D material that improves sodium-ion transport and compatibility with sodium metal in all-solid-state batteries. The advance targets a key safety obstacle that has held back sodium-based solid-state cells, with potential to lower grid storage costs and reduce reliance on lithium.

items.title: Peak Energy to Build First US Grid-Scale Sodium-Ion Factory
items.summary: Sodium-ion battery startup Peak Energy says its $71 million California factory will be the first US facility dedicated to grid-scale sodium-ion energy storage systems. Shipments from the plant are expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: L-H Battery Starts Lithium-Ion Cell Output at Ohio Plant
items.summary: L-H Battery Company began lithium-ion cell production this month at its Jeffersonville, Ohio plant, targeting both automotive and stationary storage applications. The launch adds new domestic cell manufacturing capacity as US developers seek to diversify supply away from imported cells.

items.title: HyperStrong to Launch Sodium-Ion BESS Domestically Before Export
items.summary: System integrator HyperStrong plans to deploy sodium-ion battery energy storage systems first in its home market of China before bringing the product to international markets, according to its president of technology. The strategy reflects a broader push by Chinese integrators to commercialize sodium-ion chemistry for grid-scale applications ahead of global rollout.

items.title: FERC Presses Grid Operators to Reform Large-Load Tariffs
items.summary: FERC issued tailored show-cause orders to all six regional grid operators, directing them to justify or reform tariffs governing how data centers and other large energy users connect to the grid, with 60 days to respond. The action, tied to five categories of reform including co-location and behind-the-meter generation rules, has major implications for how storage and generation interconnect with large new loads.

items.title: New Jersey Governor Signs Bills Reshaping Transmission Rules
items.summary: New Jersey's governor signed legislation aimed at cutting transmission owners' return on equity, establishing data center tariffs, and requiring state approval for so-called 'supplementary' transmission projects. The measures are part of a broader state effort to control rising grid costs tied to large load growth.

items.title: US Storage Developers Race July 4 Safe-Harbor Deadline
items.summary: Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, storage projects had to demonstrate physical construction progress by July 4, 2026 to qualify for existing investment tax credit rules and avoid stricter new Foreign Entity of Concern (FEOC) restrictions. Developers who missed the deadline are now exploring alternative paths to preserve tax credit eligibility for their projects.

items.title: Brazil Publishes Framework for First Battery Storage Auction
items.summary: Brazil's government published rules for its first dedicated battery storage auction, setting up two procurement rounds with 15-year contracts and technical requirements for grid-scale systems. The framework comes as curtailment of renewable generation rises, creating pressure for new flexibility resources.

items.title: Australia Adds First Nations Set-Aside to Capacity Scheme
items.summary: The Australian government introduced a dedicated First Nations Set Aside pilot within both Capacity Investment Scheme Tenders 9 and 10, aiming to boost Indigenous participation in the national storage and renewables buildout. The pilot is part of the broader scheme that underpins Australia's large-scale battery deployment targets.
